core_points.title_en: Value and mechanism of private sector information sharing
core_points.title_zh: 私营部门信息共享的价值和机制
core_points.reason: This core point covers the definition of private sector information sharing and an example that illustrates why it is valuable, helping organizations identify and mitigate risk.

core_points.title_en: Examples of private sector information sharing mechanisms
core_points.title_zh: 私营部门信息共享机制示例
core_points.reason: This core point covers the various methods of private sector information sharing, including specific legal and regulatory examples from the US, UK, Singapore, and EU.

core_points.title_en: Considerations and requirements for private sector information sharing
core_points.title_zh: 私营部门信息共享的考虑因素和要求
core_points.reason: This core point covers key considerations for organizations joining private sector information sharing, including data protection obligations, impact assessments, resource allocation, and the resulting enhancement to AML/CFT programs.
